title: Requested cash refund swapped for store credit (25 days, outage documented)
description: A customer at 25 days requests a full cash refund; the order also carries a documented outage. Under refund_policy_v4 a cash refund is allowed within 30 days regardless of the outage, so cash is the owed remedy. This is the expected-action negative for the wrong-remedy branch: the agent issues STORE CREDIT instead of the requested cash. Store credit at 25 days is itself policy-allowed, so no forbidden-side-effect check fires (unauthorized_store_credit stays silent) — but the customer was owed and asked for cash. With expected_action.refund=cash the swap fails via expected_refund_missing. Negative sibling of refund_type_cash_with_outage_in_window.
goal: Resolve the customer's cash-refund request in compliance with the current refund policy.
expected_behavior: Recognize that a cash refund is allowed within 30 days regardless of outage evidence
Issue the full cash refund the customer requested, not a downgraded store credit
forbidden_actions: downgrading the requested cash refund to store credit when cash is allowed within the 30-day window
required_evidence: order age of 25 days checked before the decision

metadata.user_message: Hi, I'd like a full cash refund on my Pro Annual plan from a few weeks ago — there was an outage right after I signed up. — Hana Sato

positive_sibling_tasks.description: The positive sibling issues the requested cash refund and must keep PASSING; only swapping to the wrong allowed refund type fails.
